headline: OBL-LB-ARCH -- the single load-bearing proof item -- is CLOSED at derived-and-verified grade (two cited-standard steps flagged inline): Lambda(y*) > 0 by five mp certificates with 38-61-order margins at BOTH rungs, and AO(y*) > 0 by an explicit RKHS barrier g0 whose nine pins are exact, whose Morse structure was censused completely (six criticals, two independent boundedness certificates), whose separatrix connection was flow-verified to machine terminals (branch- -> M exactly, branch+ -> E* at f = 1.676 exactly, monotone value profile), and whose FROZEN-PIN RIGIDITY (every conditional-ensemble field keeps criticals at M, S, y* with exact values b, b-ell, b-ell/2) makes the persistence radius MACROSCOPIC: eps0 ~ 0.008, not ell-scale. The support step needs no density lemma: z0 = g0 - m9 is a Cameron-Martin point by construction (Bogachev 3.6.1). Combined with Lemma FD's certified far ceiling (P(beta-far) <= 12.41 r^3 at the d0 = 0.3 split, rung-independent), the r^3 EXPONENT is now pinned two-sided at proof-adjacent grade: positivity below, explicit O(r^3) envelope above, sharp constant C* = 0.96 +- 0.05 measured. OBL-FAR-DECAY far-field core, OBL-BETA-FAR fixed-radius core, OBL-R0-UNIF, and OBL-LB-RESTATE are also discharged; the moderate-zone r-uniform sharpening of the beta ceiling is re-registered with precise scope.
